people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
translations.bsb: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
translations.kjv: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst
translations.asv: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion; for great in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.
